name: usage-quota
description: Know your Claude limits before they hit you (Live band above the Claude Code prompt): 5 Hour and Weekly usage (whole account) with a live usage forecast against limit resets, alerts, usage history, 16 languages, what this chat took, context window usage, one-click Compact and Auto compact.

language.title: Language
language.description: The band's language. auto follows the desktop app's language, else your system's (LC_ALL, LANG), else English.

notify.title: Alerts
notify.description: Notify when a 5 Hour or Weekly limit reaches the alert %, when it is reached, and when a 5 Hour window you were warned about resets. A system notification in the terminal; a message in the desktop app.

alertAt.title: Alert at %
alertAt.description: The % of a limit that raises the first alert (50 to 100).

chatCost.title: Show what this chat used
chatCost.description: Show "This chat used X% – last reply Y%" under the 5 Hour bar.

statusLine.title: Usage in the status line
statusLine.description: While the band is off (/quota), show "5H 7% · Weekly 57% · Context 38%" in the status line.

autoCompactAt.title: Auto compact default %
autoCompactAt.description: The context % that Auto compact starts from when you turn it on (15 to 99).

limitColors.title: Limit colours
limitColors.description: Three %s for the 5 Hour and Weekly bars: grey up to the first, yellow at the second, red at the third.

contextColors.title: Context colours
contextColors.description: Three %s for the context: grey up to the first, yellow at the second, red at the third.
